svg.title: Container delivery pipeline on AWS
svg.desc: Container delivery pipeline on AWS. 10 components in 3 groups. Connections: Developer to GitHub; GitHub to AWS CodePipeline (source); AWS CodeBuild to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon Simple Notification Service; Amazon Simple Notification Service to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeBuild to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (push image); AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon ECS (deploy); AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon ECS (deploy); AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon CloudWatch (alarms); Amazon ECS to Amazon CloudWatch (metrics).

text.tspan: AWS CodePipeline builds each push from GitHub, deploys it to staging, waits for approval and releases it to production on
